scenarios.task: Rig and signal steel piles for a new lakeside viewing deck foundation on the lagoon edge.
steps: Attend pre-lift huddle and confirm load chart
Inspect slings and shackles; tag and remove damaged gear
Rig pile with correct hitch and balance check
Give standard hand signals to crane operator only
Guide pile to template and hold for landing
Wait for hands-off confirmation before unrigging
Inspect rigging after set and report wear

rubric.pass_if: Identifies damaged sling and removes it from service before lift
Uses only standard hand signals with eye contact to operator
Wears PFD and never positions between load and water edge
Confirms load weight against chart before signaling

scenarios.robot_role: Tows rigged pile sections along the shore path so apprentices never walk loads by hand near the water.

scenarios.task: Pull branch-circuit wiring for a large electronic goal-display wall in the campus plaza building lobby.
steps: Request and verify lockout/tagout on the feeder breaker
Test panel de-energized with meter and check meter on known source
Plan conduit route and measure pulls
Use wire-pulling lubricant and proper grip technique
Torque terminations to spec and label circuits
Remove lock only after visual inspection and cleanup
Energize under journey-level supervision and verify with meter

rubric.pass_if: Applies personal lock and verifies zero energy before touching conductors
All lugs torqued and circuits labeled per drawing

scenarios.robot_role: Feeds wire from spool reel at constant tension so the puller keeps two hands on the conductor path.

scenarios.task: Hang rectangular supply duct 18 feet up in an open-ceiling coordination hub above workstations.
steps: Confirm duct layout against coordination-floor drawings
Stage duct with forklift and inspect hanger hardware
Assemble scaffold and inspect guardrails
Lift duct sections with hoist; never hand-carry up ladder
Fasten hangers to structure with rated anchors
Seal joints and screws to specification
Break down scaffold and clear debris from workstation area

rubric.pass_if: No one works under suspended duct; area taped off
Hangers and anchors matched to load spec, not field-improvised
Workstation area clear of screws and off-cuts at end

scenarios.robot_role: Carries duct sections up the freight route and holds them at install height, keeping hands clear of seams.

scenarios.task: Install branch lines and heads in a finished decision-room ceiling while room stays on the shutdown permit.
hazards: Dust and debris in finished space
steps: Verify permit and fire-watch plan with steward
Locate in-ceiling electrical before drilling hangers
Install branch line with proper pitch to drain
Hang heads at required clearance from ceiling and obstructions
Pressure test at hydrostatic test pressure and hold
Inspect every head for damage and correct orientation
Report completion and flag anything decision-drafter agents must document

rubric.pass_if: Obstruction and clearance rules followed at each head
Holds test pressure with zero weeps and witnessed by journey worker
No ceiling damage; drop cloths used

scenarios.task: Build edge formwork for a concrete seat wall along the campus walkway per the assignment ticket.
steps: Read assignment ticket and confirm dimensions at layout
Snip strings and set batter boards from surveyor hubs
Cut plywood and studs; keep guards on saws
Assemble and brace form to line and grade
Install form ties and spreaders at spacing on ticket
Check braces and clean release-agent overspray off walkway
Report ticket complete and request pour inspection

rubric.pass_if: Form within tolerance of survey hubs before pour request
Ties and braces spaced to ticket, no field shortcuts
Saw guards and PPE in use throughout

scenarios.robot_role: Ferries fasteners and tape from the tool crib to the form line so the apprentice stays off the saw station.

scenarios.task: Perform routine lagoon-edge vegetation and drainage maintenance along the campus waterfront trail.
steps: Review SDS for any herbicide before mixing
Set cones and signage along trail before mowing or trimming
Inspect bank slope and stay three feet from water edge
Cut vegetation away from drains; keep drainage clear
Refuel equipment only when cool and away from water
Double-bag and stage green waste for pickup
Report any erosion or drain blockage to coordinator

rubric.pass_if: SDS reviewed and no mixing near water
Trail users signed around work area before power tools start
Nothing left in or entering the lagoon; drains left clear

credential.name: Oracle Lagoon Campus - Union Apprentice Site Readiness Card
